name: Business Ladders
description: Eight Business tests rebuilt as ten-rung difficulty ladders (not the Business Ladder's adoption levels): invoices, payslips, expenses, reconciliation, the customer list, contract changes, database questions and the support queue. Each rung adds volume and stacks more policy rules; a rung is passed at 90% of its points. The headline is the ladder height alongside the Business Score. Every answer is machine-checked against a solver. Never mixed into the Gauntlet Index. Tests still being built appear as coming soon.
